question: What Is the Difference Between MOV, FILL and COP in PLC?
body_html:
PLC data move instructions copy values between memory locations: MOV copies one value, FILL writes one value into a whole array, and COP copies a block of consecutive elements.

InstructionActionTypical use
MOVSource to one destinationHMI setpoint to PID block
FILLOne value to Array[0..N]Reset or initialise an array
COPArray to array, same lengthCopy recipes or snapshot data

All three run every scan while the rung is true.
